behaviors.name: portal
behaviors.description: Render the node into document.body so overlays escape stacking contexts.

behaviors.name: clickOutside
behaviors.description: Invoke a callback when a pointer event lands outside the node.

behaviors.name: escape
behaviors.description: Invoke a callback on Escape keydown while the node is mounted.

behaviors.name: focusTrap
behaviors.description: Keep Tab focus cycling inside the node (dialogs, sheets).

behaviors.name: scrollLock
behaviors.description: Lock body scroll while mounted (reference-counted acquire/release).

behaviors.name: useFloating
behaviors.description: Anchor-position a floating element against a reference (@floating-ui).

behaviors.name: positionAt
behaviors.description: One-shot floating position calculation for a coordinate anchor.

behaviors.name: rovingTabindex
behaviors.description: Arrow-key roving focus for composite widgets (menus, listboxes).

behaviors.name: optimisticOverlay
behaviors.description: Client-side id → value overlay that shadows server truth until reload (instant drag-drop, toggles).
